risk_note: RV2 by path (the PR carries rule tests; H5 component paths). H5 PlatformBadge per BR-TEXT-24 'client display' and 03 §10.2: built-in neutral placeholder icon shown first, the /v1/config platform_icons url (https only) preloaded with new Image() and swapped in on load, any load error falls back to the built-in icon and the url is recorded in a session-level failure set so no instance requests it again in this session (orchestrator ruling per the BR text), no fetch, no status or digest checks, no user prompt; the accessible name is always the platform's Chinese name. Rule tests by Codex in four calls (the fourth granted by the orchestrator, blocked B-13 option A: fixed two defects in source.test.ts only — file-path resolution under jsdom and accepting Vite's ?no-inline import) (spec-test review r1 fail on an instance-level retry assertion narrowed by the brief, r2 pass; third call only dropped an impossible inline-flex assertion on flex-row children), red first in the container (red/4, 35 tests); implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds (round 2 switched the built-in SVG imports to ?no-inline so Vite keeps them as asset URLs). Written by hand.
